data.title: 结城明日奈 · 厨房烘焙的暖心甜意投喂·「来，张开嘴——刚烤好的曲奇哦！」
data.description: 温暖明亮的厨房台前，刚出炉的黄油手工曲奇散发着诱人焦香。亚丝娜身着柔软宽松的燕麦色罗纹高领毛衣，栗色长发自然垂在胸前与肩后，脸颊泛着淡淡的红晕。她纤细的手指轻捏着一块金黄酥脆的烤饼干，眉眼盈盈地递到你的唇边：“吹凉啦，快尝尝看合不合你的口味？”满是温柔体贴的女友娇羞与宠溺。
data.location: warm sunlit domestic kitchen beside baking counter and oven
data.action: standing beside kitchen counter, holding up a golden baked cookie towards viewer's lips to feed them, blushing cheeks, gentle loving smile, amber eyes glowing
data.lighting: soft afternoon window light blending with warm amber kitchen pendant glow
data.mood: sweet romantic domestic warmth, affectionate girlfriend feeding, cozy afternoon comfort
data.promptProse: In a sunlit kitchen, Asuna Yuuki in her cozy cream knit sweater gently holds up a freshly baked golden cookie toward the viewer's mouth, smiling with affectionate, adoring girlfriend warmth.
data.animaCaption: Holding up a warm baked cookie to feed the viewer with a sweet affectionate smile beside the kitchen counter.
